run_topdown_pose_demo: run topdown pose estimation on an image or video using mmdet and mmpose models
run_pose_demo_webcam: run real-time topdown pose estimation from webcam input with mmdet detection and mmpose
run_pose_demo_video: run topdown pose estimation on a video file and save output video with keypoints
run_pose_demo_save_predictions: run pose estimation on an image and save predicted keypoints to a JSON file
run_pose_demo_draw_heatmap: run pose estimation with heatmap visualization enabled for predicted keypoints on an image
